title: Parish and Witness
author: Ansel Dunmore
blurb: August Lockridge, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
